Two spring rolls (rice paper rolls with chicken and lettuce) sit on the plate. Each looks about 70-80 g, so about 150 g in total at roughly 1.3 kcal/g, or about 195 kcal. Because the rolls look small and lean, I'll go with about 180 kcal.

The bowl holds leftover fruit: a few grapes, a piece of melon or pineapple, and a piece of tomato or watermelon. That is about 40 g and 25 kcal.

Total: about 190 g and 205 kcal. The mug and glass look empty, so I left them out.
